children.text: Isolated the phone number so it reads left to right.
0.0 to 1.2 s  ·  The agent calls Dualkit
Light pulses run along each wire from the agent chips into the node, 300 ms apart. The node spins while it loads the skills and the tag counts up.

A pulse leaves the node for the panel. The panel fades in, then each row lands 200 ms apart with a short blur. The bdi ring draws round the phone number.

The check bar fills to 20 of 20, the note lands, then the pay button turns solid. It holds for 3.5 s, then the rows clear and it runs again.
